opening.argument: The video presents GMX on Arbitrum as a crypto-financial opportunity tied to a stated return of “+35% per annum.” The narration reinforces that representation by reporting “the income was about $ 8” and that commissions are “about 35% per annum,” then characterizing the GMX exchange and JLP token as “a fairly conservative instrument” with “a quite good percentage.” The displayed GMX Arbitrum interface further places the claim in an investment-report context, showing staked balances and earned ETH worth approximately $7.90. A subscription direction also appears in the description. The supplied material does not establish that joining Telegram, subscribing, or making a specific transaction was required to obtain the claimed annualized return, but it does present a financial instrument, commission income, and an attractive annualized percentage as an investment opportunity.

citations.quote: DEX Exchange GMX Network Arbitrum +35% per annum
the income was about $ 8. Commissions are paid on air and in the per annum it is about 35% per annum.
For a fairly conservative instrument, which is the Jamex exchange and the JLP token, this is a quite good percentage.
